part.text:
To log every request to the console in this Next.js app, I've created a middleware file at `/middleware.ts` that logs request details including method, URL, path, and timestamp. The middleware is configured to match all routes using the matcher `/:path*`.

The middleware will now log all incoming requests to the console automatically.
